label: defeated opponent
definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest; direction is winner to defeated opponent.
scope_notes: Preserves the previous defeated-opponent predicate. Explicit beat, defeat, victory over or completed sweep qualify. Losing, playing, facing, trading or standings alone do not. Different historical games can supply both wins and losses; a clear win supports the fact but other assignments remain mixed evidence.

facts.reason: Toronto Blue Jays defeat and beat New York Yankees; contract/offer evidence is a different relation.
Giants lose to Eagles, face them and have an opener against them; none of these rows establishes Giants defeating Eagles.
Mets beat, defeat and sweep Braves; play and games-behind rows are broader or different evidence.
Mets beat and sweep Yankees and have a victory over them; a separate loss and facing/playing rows are mixed.
Eagles beat Giants and have a victory over them, despite other rows describing losses and participation.
